products.name: Forest Green Leather Recliner
products.description: A single-seat recliner in deep forest-green leatherette, with a high pillow-top back, thick padded arms and a manual lever on the side. Other colours are usually on the floor beside it.
details: Forest green with cream contrast stitching
Pillow-top arms and zoned back cushions

products.name: Cognac Tufted Sofa Set
products.description: A three-seater and two matching armchairs in cognac leatherette, square-grid tufted on the seat and back, with short chrome block feet. Shown with a curved glass coffee table on a white base.
details: Glass coffee table sold separately in the showroom

products.name: Light Grey Recliner Sofa with Console
products.description: A two-seat recliner in light grey microfibre with a centre console, cup holders and a padded lift lid. Manual pull handles sit on the outer sides.
details: Cup holders and storage in the console

products.name: Black Tufted Three-Seater
products.description: A low, boxy three-seater in matte black leatherette. One long bench seat, grid tufting on the back and seat, wide track arms and short chrome legs.

products.name: Four-Drawer Steel Filing Cabinet
products.description: A full-height four-drawer metal filing cabinet in light grey, with silver pull handles and a keyed lock. Useful in an office, clinic or school store.

products.name: Beige Recliner Living Set
products.description: A matching recliner three-seater, two-seater with cup-holder console, and armchair in beige microfibre with white contrast stitching. Round marble-look nesting tables with gold frames sit in front.

products.name: Chocolate Z-Frame Lounge Set
products.description: A compact two-seater and two armchairs in chocolate-brown leatherette, set in a light wood Z-shaped side frame. Low lounge height — good for a small sitting room or waiting area.
details: Light wood Z-frame arms and legs

products.name: Charcoal Tufted Two-Seater
products.description: A two-seater in charcoal leatherette with button tufting on the back, straight track arms and low chrome legs. Neat enough for a flat, firm enough for everyday sitting.

products.name: Black Lounge Set with Wood Arm Caps
products.description: A three-seater and two chairs in matte black leatherette, with a dark wood panel on top of each arm — somewhere to rest a cup. Comes with a matching two-tier coffee table.

products.name: Black Leather Reclining Sofa
products.description: A glossy black leatherette reclining sofa with pillow-top arms, bustle-back cushions and a pull lever on the side. Contrast stitching runs along the seams. Grey and beige versions are often nearby in the showroom.

products.name: Mahogany Two-Tier Coffee Table
products.description: A rectangular coffee table in polished reddish-brown hardwood, with a lower shelf for remotes and magazines and thick square legs. Simple, heavy, and easy to wipe.

products.name: Obsidian and Walnut Reception Counter
products.description: An L-shaped reception desk with a high visitor counter and a lower staff desk. Matte black laminate on the body, walnut-grain worktops, and a recessed kick plate so it sits cleanly on tiled floors.
details: Matte black laminate and walnut grain
Built for reception and lobby use

products.name: White and Oak L-Shaped Office Desk
products.description: A two-tone L-desk in matte white with a light-oak raised platform and a cable grommet on the side. Diamond-shaped panels decorate the left return. Suits a manager’s office or a compact studio.
details: Matte white and light oak laminate

products.name: Round Walnut Meeting Table
products.description: A round dark-walnut meeting table on a cross-shaped wood pedestal with chrome glides. Shown with black cantilever visitor chairs — chairs can be ordered with the table.

products.name: White Round Dining Table
products.description: A round white table on a powder-coated steel X-base. Compact enough for a kitchen or a four-person dining nook. Chairs are sold separately.

products.name: Round Dark-Walnut Conference Table
products.description: A circular conference table in dark walnut laminate, thick edge, on an X-pedestal with chrome levelling feet. Made for a small boardroom or a home office meeting corner.

products.name: Four-Person Workstation Cluster
products.description: A four-desk cluster with walnut-grain tops, charcoal privacy screens and a pedestal (drawer plus cupboard) for each person. Built for an open office that still needs a bit of separation.
details: Four workstations in a plus layout

products.name: Light-Grain Reception Desk with Oak Slats
products.description: A reception counter in pale wood-grain laminate. The front has a diagonal cut that shows a panel of vertical oak slats — a bit of texture without looking busy.

products.name: White and Blue Reception Desk
products.description: A high-gloss white L-shaped reception desk with royal-blue capping and a ribbed blue front panel. Two heights: a standing counter for visitors and a lower desk for the receptionist.

products.name: Gloss Mahogany Coffee Table
products.description: A rectangular two-tier coffee table in glossy mahogany-stained wood, with a lower shelf and thick square legs. Same family as the living-room coffee table on the floor.

products.name: Boardroom Conference Table
products.description: A long rectangular conference table with a dark wood-grain top, metal edge trim and three charcoal pedestals. Sized for a full boardroom — about twelve to fourteen seats depending on the chairs.
details: Dark wood veneer top, metal edge

products.name: Mahogany-Frame Leather Office Chair
products.description: A high-back visitor or boardroom chair in black leatherette, with a polished mahogany wood frame, curved wood arms and four fixed legs. It does not swivel or roll.
details: Mahogany / cherry wood frame and arms
Fixed base — not a swivel chair

products.name: Black High-Back Conference Chair
products.description: A black high-back task chair with a padded headrest, T-armrests and a chrome five-star base on casters. Sold per chair; we usually keep a set around the conference tables.

products.name: Black Tufted Club Chair
products.description: A boxy black leatherette armchair with square-grid tufting on the seat and back, wide track arms and short chrome legs. Works in a sitting room or as a guest chair in an office.

products.name: Black Sofa Set with Honey-Oak Arms
products.description: A 3+2+1 set in black leatherette with light honey-oak panels on the armrests, plus a matching two-tier coffee table in the same wood. A practical lounge set for home or a reception.
details: Matching coffee table included in the set

products.name: Red and Black Racing Chair
products.description: A racing-style high-back chair in black and red PU leather, diamond-quilted on the seat and back, with a headrest pillow, lumbar pillow and a pull-out footrest.
details: Black and red PU leather, diamond quilting

products.name: Round Meeting Set with Cantilever Chairs
products.description: A charcoal round table on a four-leg pedestal, with four black cantilever chairs — chrome frames, padded arms and a diamond-quilted leatherette panel on the upper back.
details: Black fabric seat, quilted leatherette back

products.name: White Reception Desk with Obsidian Shelf
products.description: A two-height reception unit in off-white laminate. The visitor shelf is charcoal, held on silver standoffs, and the whole piece sits on a recessed black plinth.

products.name: Light Oak Lockable Sideboard
products.description: A two-door low cabinet in light oak grain, silver bar handles, a centre lock and a dark kick plate. Fine as office storage or a living-room sideboard.

products.name: Pale Reception Counter with Oak Slats
products.description: A pale-grey wood-grain reception desk. The front is split: a solid panel on one side and vertical oak slats on the other, cut on a diagonal.

products.name: Charcoal and Walnut Reception Desk
products.description: An L-shaped reception desk with a charcoal front, walnut-grain counter and a lower staff worktop. A black kick plate keeps the base off the floor.

products.name: Two-Tone Lockable Storage Cabinets
products.description: A pair of waist-high two-door cabinets with vertical black handles and locks. One is white doors on a light-oak body; the other is black doors on a white body. Sold as a pair or asked for singly in the showroom.

products.name: Grey and Oak L-Shaped Executive Desk
products.description: An L-shaped desk in light grey with a light-oak raised platform, a built-in power module, a side cable grommet and diamond-shaped accents on the front return.

products.name: Walnut Reception Counter with White Panel
products.description: A standing-height reception counter in horizontal walnut grain, with a matte white front panel and a slightly lower inner desk for the person working behind it.

products.name: Jewel-Tone Velvet Tub Chairs
products.description: Barrel chairs in plush velvet with a wrap-around back and slim brushed-gold legs. Shown in ruby, olive, terracotta and mustard — pick a colour or mix a set.
details: Several jewel colours on the floor

products.name: Mahogany Suit Valet
products.description: A standing valet for a jacket and trousers: a curved mahogany hanger, a chrome trouser bar and a round weighted wood base. For a bedroom or a dressing corner — not a wall mirror.
details: Polished chrome hanger support and trouser rail

products.name: Made-to-Order Conversation
products.description: Bring a photo, a measurement or a sketch. We will sit with you in Juja, agree timber, fabric and size, and give you a written quote. The visit fee comes off the order if you go ahead.
